comment:
* Utility methods to assist with stream processing.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static void drain(InputStream inStr) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Read stream till EOF is encountered.
     *
     * @param inStr stream to be emptied.
     * @throws IOException in case of underlying IOException.

methods.name: public static byte[] readAll(InputStream inStr) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Read stream fully, returning contents in a byte array.
     *
     * @param inStr stream to be read.
     * @return a byte array representing the contents of inStr.
     * @throws IOException in case of underlying IOException.

methods.name: public static byte[] readAllLimited(InputStream inStr, int limit) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Read from inStr up to a maximum number of bytes, throwing an exception if more the maximum amount
     * of requested data is available.
     *
     * @param inStr stream to be read.
     * @param limit maximum number of bytes that can be read.
     * @return a byte array representing the contents of inStr.
     * @throws IOException in case of underlying IOException, or if limit is reached on inStr still has data in it.

methods.name: public static int readFully(InputStream inStr, byte[] buf) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Fully read in buf's length in data, or up to EOF, whichever occurs first,
     *
     * @param inStr the stream to be read.
     * @param buf the buffer to be read into.
     * @return the number of bytes read into the buffer.
     * @throws IOException in case of underlying IOException.

methods.name: public static int readFully(InputStream inStr, byte[] buf, int off, int len) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Fully read in len's bytes of data into buf, or up to EOF, whichever occurs first,
     *
     * @param inStr the stream to be read.
     * @param buf the buffer to be read into.
     * @param off offset into buf to start putting bytes into.
     * @param len  the number of bytes to be read.
     * @return the number of bytes read into the buffer.
     * @throws IOException in case of underlying IOException.

methods.name: public static void pipeAll(InputStream inStr, OutputStream outStr) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Write the full contents of inStr to the destination stream outStr.
     *
     * @param inStr source input stream.
     * @param outStr destination output stream.
     * @throws IOException in case of underlying IOException.

methods.name: public static long pipeAllLimited(InputStream inStr, long limit, OutputStream outStr) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Write up to limit bytes of data from inStr to the destination stream outStr.
     *
     * @param inStr source input stream.
     * @param limit the maximum number of bytes allowed to be read.
     * @param outStr destination output stream.
     * @throws IOException in case of underlying IOException, or if limit is reached on inStr still has data in it.

methods.name: public static void writeBufTo(ByteArrayOutputStream buf, OutputStream output) throws IOException

methodNames: public static void drain(InputStream inStr) throws IOException
public static byte[] readAll(InputStream inStr) throws IOException
public static byte[] readAllLimited(InputStream inStr, int limit) throws IOException
public static int readFully(InputStream inStr, byte[] buf) throws IOException
public static int readFully(InputStream inStr, byte[] buf, int off, int len) throws IOException
public static void pipeAll(InputStream inStr, OutputStream outStr) throws IOException
public static long pipeAllLimited(InputStream inStr, long limit, OutputStream outStr) throws IOException
public static void writeBufTo(ByteArrayOutputStream buf, OutputStream output) throws IOException
